reading_rules: a ramp is the last quarter of the read minus the first quarter; positive means the end of the read is worse
the overlap instrument does not trust the quality strings, which is the point: NovaSeq bins quality, so a flat Q profile is not by itself evidence of a flat error rate

the overlap mismatch rate is the SUM of both mates' error rates at the paired positions, so the level is about twice a single mate's error rate; the shape and the comparison between mates are the readouts
only overlapping pairs enter the overlap instrument, which selects short molecules, and a mismatch cannot be blamed on one mate without using the quality scores this instrument avoids

the two mates' overlap profiles are ONE mismatch profile in two coordinate systems: mate 1's late positions pair with mate 2's early ones, so a ramp in one appears inverted in the other and the overall rates are equal by construction. Only the shape, and whether any positional structure exists at all, is a readout

the mate-mapping asymmetry must be read from the length_matched block: mate 2 is 93 nt against mate 1's 107 after the non-template trim, and a shorter read maps less often for reasons unrelated to quality
